base.language: English natural language; retained code language policy

initial_sources.code: restricted Stack v3 under admitted source/language policy

base.policy: A pre-results broad starting recipe, not an optimum. R1 qualifies capacity, exposure and a bounded repeat schedule; source substitution requires an explicit pre-results materialization successor and paired controls. No E1/E2/E4 search is active.
base.production_authority: Conditional old 150B operating envelope does not establish source supply or new quotas. Re-cost actual retained stocks, source exposures and site transfer before production.
base.exposure_rule: Account per source and family across stable, decay, extension and supervision; 320B/150B average exposure does not prove every source can tolerate its own reuse.
base.schedule: Use one stable mixture and the same broad mixture through a 20% WSD decay by default. No optimized decay-mixture claim.

long_context.unit: coherent document, work, repository snapshot, or ordered history
long_context.sampling: Boundary-aligned windows; arbitrary concatenation is not long-dependency supervision. BOS/EOS does not imply attention isolation or recurrent reset.
curriculum_task_families: apply an early rule to a later event
long_context.treatment_boundary: The controlled intervention replaces a fixed share of assistant-target supervision with verified dependency-requiring tasks. Natural-document continuation is shared. Do not bundle different continuation, answer style and supervision budgets into an attribution claim.
matching: same length bins and evidence-position coverage
matched assistant-target volume within predeclared tolerance
long_context.verification: Verify every synthetic label against retained evidence; exact tasks use executable checks, free-form tasks use independent checking plus blinded human sample review. Report verifier failures and teacher lineage/cost.

separation.unit: family of documents, editions, forks, histories and task variants
separation.legacy_audits: D5 and E2 audit identities remain unopened retained exclusions. They are not renamed or consumed as new long-context tests.
separation.heldout_benchmarks: Freeze exact releases and exclusions before generating training tasks; prohibit benchmark question/answer/template conversion into training examples.
separation.runtime_binding: Existing firewall and launch receipt implementation must be qualified for the new partitions before scientific training; no plan is a receipt.

preparation_transition.stocks: Reuse verified text/token caches only under matching identities; old quotas are historical requirements.
preparation_transition.in_flight: Do not interrupt or restart running acquisition here. Existing finite jobs may finish their already recorded units; reconcile actual completion before follow-on work. No automatic old full-wave expansion.
preparation_transition.critical_path: Prepare qualified source-separated banks before final weights; forecast excludes no storage, verification or site transfer cost.
